verdict.rationale: Brevo documents a drag-and-drop email builder, responsive and ready-made templates (also retrievable as SMTP templates via the API), and per-recipient personalization through dynamic variables. Correct rendering across email clients is only implied by the word "responsive", and personalization is documented mainly in the API batch-send context rather than as editor tokens. missing for 10: documented cross-client rendering/preview testing, explicit personalization tokens inside the visual editor, brand kit/on-brand style controls, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can design on-brand emails with a visual editor, reusable templates, and personalization tokens that render correctly across clients

citations.quote: Craft polished emails fast—just drag, drop, and send.
Jumpstart campaigns with responsive templates tailored to your industry and use case.
Personalize content for each recipient using dynamic variables.
Skip the learning curve with ready-made templates
